scope: Released local games and editions with a runtime route to investigate on Flip 2, including Android through ArmadaOS Waydroid. Excludes closed online games, Switch 2 exclusives, arcade-only hardware, DLC, demos and distribution-only utilities. ROM hacks remain user entries. Inclusion is not a device playability claim.
